cover:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished painted key art / main-menu background for an original 2D game, Kalyana Kathal, a Tamil cinema romance action comedy.
Create a wide landscape 16:9 production-quality illustration. Vintage 1930s hand-inked rubber-hose animation meets hand-painted 1970s Tamil film poster art. Rich gouache, subtle aged paper grain, expressive rounded silhouettes, beautifully shaded dark ink outlines, layered depth, rim light, deep petrol teal, warm ochre, dusty coral, cream. A warm romantic Chennai college courtyard at late-afternoon golden hour, painted arches, climbing bougainvillea, old notice board, filter-coffee canteen awning, distant palm trees and dramatic cream clouds, jasmine and folded love letters dancing gently across the composition.
On the RIGHT HALF stand the adult protagonists: Murugan, a charming young Tamil man with warm medium-brown skin, a swept black quiff, expressive large dark eyes, mustard short-sleeve shirt rolled at cuffs, dark teal trousers, white gloves and oversized vintage oxford shoes, holding a small cream envelope sealed with a red heart. Sharmila, an independent adult Tamil woman with warm brown skin, expressive dark eyes, long thick black braid decorated with jasmine, a tiny bindi, elegant coral salwar kameez with teal dupatta and gold trim, playful confident smile, carrying her theatre script. Appealing, professionally designed animation characters with consistent anatomy, tapered expressive hands, appealing posed energy, not crude geometric figures. Their friendly romantic dynamic is conveyed by eye contact, not touching.
LEFT HALF is mostly quiet atmospheric dark teal foliage and soft courtyard shadows with elegant negative space for a large in-game title and menu buttons to be rendered separately. Strong cinematic stage lighting, affectionate comedy, nuanced painted details, polished indie-game promotional quality.
No lettering, no title, no readable writing, no UI, no borders, no watermark, no logos. This is an original game; do not copy existing franchise characters. Full-bleed artwork, no white margins.
school:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background painting for an original 2D side-view game. Use the attached illustration as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: richly textured hand-painted gouache, vintage Tamil cinema poster warmth, classic hand-inked animation backgrounds, deep teal shadows, glowing ochre and coral, elegant worn architectural details, subtle film grain, detailed foliage, cinematic depth and light. Create a NEW EMPTY ENVIRONMENT, not a poster and not a screenshot. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape. Camera is a fixed side-view theatrical platform-game stage, with a clear level walkable floor baseline at exactly 82% of image height. Keep the middle horizontal gameplay band open and uncluttered; scenery is behind the characters, not in front of their feet. The foreground bottom 18% is unobstructed warm textured floor continuing all the way to the bottom edge. No people, no characters, no letters, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no white margins. Do not include the protagonists from the reference.
Scene: A nostalgic 1999 Tamil Nadu government school corridor. Long red-oxide floor, cream and weathered sage-green plaster, rhythm of old arched classroom doors, sun streaming from a leafy courtyard through arches, a wooden notice board with blank layered paper rectangles, a bell, terracotta pots, scattered very subtle chalk dust. Warm hopeful morning, polished painted-animation background with impeccable perspective. Place the floor-to-wall line at 82% image height. Keep a large clear arena center.

hero_sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished transparent game animation sprite atlas, NOT a concept poster. Reference image establishes the exact adult Murugan face, black swept quiff, warm medium-brown skin, appealing hand-inked vintage Tamil-cinema / rubber-hose animation art, gouache shading and large vintage oxford shoes. Create ONE 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW REGULAR GRID atlas on a genuinely transparent background, exactly 16 evenly spaced full-body character sprites. Every cell is equal size. Each character is fully inside its cell with at least 12% empty padding, same height and scale, feet aligned at 92% of the cell height, no clipping, no cast shadow, no scene, no labels, no grid lines. Image shape square, high resolution. ALL sprites face RIGHT in 3/4 side view, classic friendly original animation hero, same identity and proportions as reference. Across EACH row the four columns are: (1) relaxed idle standing, (2) running stride left foot forward, (3) running stride right foot forward, (4) throwing a small love letter with outstretched right arm. Each row has one CONSISTENT outfit: ROW ONE cream school shirt with dark teal trousers; ROW TWO mustard rolled-sleeve college shirt and teal trousers as in reference; ROW THREE pale blue corporate shirt, loosened dark tie and charcoal trousers; ROW FOUR ivory wedding shirt and cream traditional veshti with gold border. School row is youthful and innocent; other rows are adult. Rich hand-painted shading, clean expressive ink silhouette, natural human faces, handsome swept black hair, warm smile. Actual transparent alpha outside each sprite, no checkerboard printed in artwork. This is an original protagonist, do not copy existing animation franchise characters.
cast_sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent 2D game cast sprite atlas, not a poster. Use the reference image as exact STYLE and SHARMILA IDENTITY reference. Vintage hand-inked Tamil cinema character illustration with rich gouache shading and appealing 1930s animation silhouettes. ONE REGULAR GRID of 3 COLUMNS and 2 ROWS, six separate FULL BODY character sprites on actual transparent background, no cast shadows, no scene. Each cell exactly the same dimensions; characters same visual scale, feet aligned at 92% of cell height, generous 12% padding all sides, no clipping, no captions, no grid lines. Square image. All characters in an expressive relaxed idle pose facing LEFT in 3/4 view toward the player, appealing readable silhouettes. Cell order left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1. PT Master Sundaram, stocky Tamil man, thick black moustache, tan sports uniform, whistle necklace, stern but caring raised eyebrow; 2. Mass Kumar, boastful young adult Tamil college senior, maroon patterned shirt, rolled cuffs, teal jeans, sunglasses resting on hair; 3. Manager Karthik, tired adult Tamil IT manager, light blue shirt, red tie, dark trousers, headset, eyeglasses and coffee mug; 4. Appa, dignified older Tamil father with grey moustache, rectangular glasses, cream shirt and white veshti with gold border, folded newspaper; 5. Amma, assertive warm older Tamil mother, elegant plum silk sari and gold borders, grey-streaked bun, bindi, gold bangles; 6. Sharmila, EXACT same adult heroine as reference, warm brown skin, long thick black braid with jasmine, expressive dark eyes, tiny bindi, coral salwar kameez with teal dupatta and gold trim, theatre script in her hands and playful independent smile. High quality production art, strong consistent anatomy, detailed faces, hand-painted materials. Absolutely transparent alpha surrounding sprites; no checkerboard printed in artwork. No extra characters.
